title: Judge blocks FCC review of ABC station licenses for now
summary: The Walt Disney Co. secured a temporary restraining order Wednesday blocking the Federal Communications Commission from moving forward with an unusually early review of ABC’s broadcast-station licenses, which the media company has called an attack on free speech by the Trump administration.

title: Hundreds of flights canceled on Thanksgiving Day as storms hit and question swirl over Iowa detonation: Morning Rundown
summary: Bad weather postpones the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade for the first-time ever.

title: Macy’s parade postponed over powerful storm
summary: Macy’s officially pressing pause on its iconic Thanksgiving Day Parade, now postponed to Saturday with a powerful storm closing in. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports.

title: Thanksgiving Day parade celebrates 100 years
summary: With the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day parade now happening days after it was scheduled, rain or shine it is marking 100 years with what is planned to be the biggest parade in their history. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk has the story.

title: Tons of toxic chemicals detonate in Iowa
summary: Two plumes filled the sky after the Army detonated nearly five tons of bomb-making material. The blast could be felt for miles. There’s no airborne lead detected throughout the region and the EPA says they’ll continue to test the air, soil and water. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster has the story.

title: Questions linger about lead pollution from Iowa blast, despite officials’ assurances
summary: Scientists and Iowa residents said questions remain about how much contamination the Army’s detonation of lead azide caused, though they were hopeful about the initial results.

title: Why more American tech startups are ditching Silicon Valley for China’s Shenzhen
summary: In the intense world of startup technology, several American companies have opted against Silicon Valley and chosen the Chinese megacity of Shenzhen.
